rv: Timeless movie-making. It is impossible to watch any of these movies and not be reminded of something that goes much deeper than the zany antics and mayhem on display. Even so incomparable a word-smith as Shakespeare, I believe, would have been impressed by the economy of dramatic presentation and the almost effortless fluency of "acting" displayed in these works. Crisp, clean dialog, wordplay that manages to redefine as much as invigorate the typical -- these short films are certainly one of American culture's most significant, and endearing, achievements.
